# Popular Science

> Popular Science publishes science reporting, technology news, videos, explainers, and feature stories spanning discoveries, inventions, and everyday curiosity.

Popular Science has covered science and technology since 1872. Its site organizes editorial coverage into topic hubs for science, technology, space, biology, AI, engineering, security, and more, alongside recurring series, video content, newsletters, and annual innovation awards.

## Home and Editorial Hubs
- [Popular Science Home](https://www.popsci.com/): Homepage featuring the latest science reporting, technology news, and editorial features.
- [Science](https://www.popsci.com/category/science/): Main science category collecting reporting across natural sciences, research, and discoveries.
- [Technology](https://www.popsci.com/category/technology/): Technology coverage focused on emerging tools, digital life, and industry developments.
- [Popular Science Videos](https://www.popsci.com/category/popular-science-videos/): Video hub for visual explainers, demonstrations, and science storytelling.
- [Ask Us Anything](https://www.popsci.com/category/ask-us-anything/): Reader-friendly explainer series answering practical and curious science questions.

## Science Topics
- [Archaeology](https://www.popsci.com/category/archaeology/): Coverage of excavations, ancient history, artifacts, and new archaeological findings.
- [Biology](https://www.popsci.com/category/biology/): Reporting on living systems, animals, genetics, ecology, and biological research.
- [Dinosaurs](https://www.popsci.com/category/dinosaurs/): Stories about paleontology, fossil discoveries, and dinosaur science.
- [Physics](https://www.popsci.com/category/physics/): Articles on fundamental forces, particles, cosmology, and applied physics research.
- [Space](https://www.popsci.com/category/space/): News and features on astronomy, spaceflight, planetary science, and exploration.

## Technology Topics
- [AI](https://www.popsci.com/category/ai/): Coverage of artificial intelligence tools, policy, research, and societal impacts.
- [Aviation](https://www.popsci.com/category/aviation/): Reporting on aircraft, aerospace systems, flight technology, and aviation industry news.
- [Engineering](https://www.popsci.com/category/engineering/): Stories about design, infrastructure, manufacturing, and technical problem-solving.
- [Internet](https://www.popsci.com/category/internet/): Coverage of online platforms, digital culture, connectivity, and web services.
- [Robots](https://www.popsci.com/category/robots/): News and features on robotics research, autonomous machines, and practical applications.
- [Security](https://www.popsci.com/category/security/): Reporting on cybersecurity, privacy, surveillance, and digital safety issues.
- [Military](https://www.popsci.com/category/military/): Coverage of defense technology, weapons systems, and military science developments.
- [Photography](https://www.popsci.com/category/photography/): Articles on cameras, imaging technology, and photographic techniques.

## Recurring Series and Shows
- [The Weirdest Thing I Learned This Week](https://www.popsci.com/category/weirdest-thing-i-learned-this-week/): Recurring series sharing unusual facts, discoveries, and science curiosities.
- [Ask Us Anything](https://www.popsci.com/category/ask-us-anything/): Ongoing explainer franchise addressing common science and technology questions.
- [Popular Science Videos](https://www.popsci.com/category/popular-science-videos/): Editorial video series covering experiments, interviews, and visual explainers.

## Awards and Special Projects
- [Best of What's New 2025](https://www.popsci.com/gear/best-of-whats-new-2025/): Annual innovation awards recognizing notable products, breakthroughs, and technologies.

## Audience and Newsletter
- [Email Signup](https://www.popsci.com/email-signup): Newsletter subscription page for Popular Science editorial updates and featured stories.
